title: 第3章 观音扬起薄凉唇似与李浪同怒目第4章 大师技艺九曲鳞刻
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
被砍掉的头颅，掉在了地上，离工台有两米远。
心火上涌，李浪的眼睛瞬间攀上赤红。
五指攥握，只感觉背后簌簌发冷，像是有恶鬼趴在他的背脊上，喷吐着死气。
绝望、茫然、愤怒，种种情绪，宛若浪涌，冲上心口，欲要喷薄而出！
艹！
是谁干的？！
“阿浪……我来的时候，你的工台就被打开了，好奇看了一眼，便看到你的雕像被损坏。”
身边一位工友，赶忙解释道。
大伙都是铺子里的学徒，太清楚这尊木雕对李浪的意义了。
可以说，这尊木雕被毁，误了跟雇主的交付日子，需要赔款事小，李浪的雕师考核失败，才算事大！
李浪已经十七岁了，按照唐氏雕工铺的规矩，不收十八岁及以上年龄的学徒。
并未与鬼神产生共鸣，身体未曾镌刻鬼神纹，没有破格录取的机会。
也就是说，今年是李浪最后一次冲击唐氏雕工铺正式雕师的机会。
所以，四目观音镇鬼童像被毁，李浪成为雕师的希望……也等于说被彻底磨灭！
李浪没有接话，他自然清楚这意味着什么……
走到了工台前，观音脑袋被砍，砍口成花刀，像是用乱斧斩去般。
李浪面色冷若冰霜。
这一看就是人为的，有人故意损坏他的木雕！
目的自然不言而喻，不想让他成为雕工铺的雕师！
雕工铺的正式雕师名额有限，每次考核，参加考核的学徒数量大概在十五个左右。

十五个学徒，争两个雕师名额。
竞争其实并不小。
愤怒于心中潮涌，李浪恨不得祭出神弩版加特林，找到那个小人，各种“突突突”
事实上……
李浪心中对于作案凶手，已然有了猜测。
不止是李浪，周围的不少学徒，其实心中也都是门清。
能做出这等事的人，肯定有背景。
一阵嘈杂声起，铺子外，一辆马车停歇下，有人下了马车进入铺子。
不少学徒正色，赶忙执礼。
来者乃是一位面容清癯，身材消瘦，穿着蓝色大褂的老人。
“叶大师！”
李浪心中虽然愤怒，但此刻还是压下怒火，抱拳执礼。
老人满头白发，但是面容红润，太阳穴囊鼓，气血强盛，双眸炯炯，宛如猎豹。
这位叶大师，名曰叶金宝，乃是唐氏雕工铺的资深雕工大师，听闻距离雕工宗师之境，只差丝毫。
除了木雕，在石雕与玉雕技艺上，也极其不俗。
自身更是一位熬炼体魄身具鬼神纹的强大修士，并修武道与鬼神道，极其强大。
哪怕在云霄城的内城，也是一位人物。
叶大师似乎惊诧于铺子里一大早的闹剧，了解了下后，眉头微微蹙起。
“你准备用来考核的木雕被人毁了？”
李浪声音有几分麻木：“是……”

叶大师负手踏足工房内，扫了一眼木雕，眼中闪过一抹可惜。
content_en:
The severed head fell to the ground, two meters away from the workbench.
The fire in his heart surged, and Li Lang's eyes instantly turned red.
He clenched his fingers and felt a chill on his back, as if there was an evil ghost lying on his back, breathing out the breath of death.
Despair, confusion, anger, all kinds of emotions, like surges, rush to the heart, ready to burst out!
grass!
Who did it? !
"Alang... When I came, your workbench was opened. I took a curious look and saw that your statue was damaged."
A worker next to him quickly explained.
Everyone is an apprentice in the shop, and they know very well the significance of this wooden sculpture to Li Lang.
It can be said that the wooden sculpture was damaged and the delivery date to the employer was missed. The need to pay compensation is a small matter, but the fact that Li Lang's carver failed the assessment is a big deal!
Li Lang is already seventeen years old. According to the rules of Tang's Carving Shop, apprentices aged eighteen and above are not accepted.
There is no resonance with ghosts and gods, no ghost or god patterns are engraved on the body, and there is no chance of exceptional admission.
In other words, this year is Li Lang's last chance to become the official carver of Tang's Carving Shop.
Therefore, the four-eyed Guanyin Town Ghost Child Statue was destroyed, and Li Lang's hope of becoming a sculptor... was also completely wiped out!
Li Lang didn't answer, of course he knew what this meant...
When he walked to the workbench, Guanyin's head was chopped off, and the cut was cut into a flower knife, as if he had chopped it off with an axe.
Li Lang's face was as cold as ice.
This seems to be man-made, someone deliberately damaged his wood carving!
The purpose is of course self-evident, I don’t want him to become the carver of the carving shop!
The number of formal carvers in the carving shop is limited, and the number of apprentices participating in each assessment is about fifteen.
Fifteen apprentices compete for two carving spots.
The competition is actually not small.
Anger surged in his heart, and Li Lang couldn't wait to use the Gatling version of the divine crossbow to find the villain, all kinds of "bursts"
In fact...
Li Lang already had a guess in his mind about the murderer.
Not only Li Lang, but many of the apprentices around him also had a clear conscience in their hearts.
Anyone who can do such a thing must have a background.
There was a noise, and outside the shop, a carriage stopped, and someone got off the carriage and entered the shop.
Many apprentices looked serious and hurriedly performed the ceremony.
The person who came was an old man with a pale face and a thin body, wearing a blue coat.
"Master Ye!"
Although Li Lang was angry in his heart, he suppressed his anger at this moment and held his fists together in salute.
The old man has white hair, but his face is ruddy, his temples are bulging, his energy and blood are strong, and his eyes are as bright as a cheetah's.
This Master Ye, named Ye Jinbao, is a senior carving master at Tang's Carving Shop. I heard that he is only a few steps away from becoming a master carving master.
In addition to wood carving, he is also very good at stone carving and jade carving.
He himself is a powerful monk who has refined his body and possesses ghost and god marks. He also practices martial arts and ghost and god ways, making him extremely powerful.
Even in the inner city of Yunxiao City, he is still a figure.
Master Ye seemed surprised by the farce in the shop early in the morning. After learning about it, he frowned slightly.
"The wood carving you planned to use for the assessment was destroyed?"
Li Lang's voice was a little numb: "Yes..."
Master Ye stepped into the workshop with his hands behind his back and glanced at the wood carvings, with a flash of regret in his eyes.
